name: FixFlags
description: Product Intelligence for AI-built products. Check a deployed URL and return a ranked Fix List across Message, Experience, and Reach with fix prompts for your AI editor.

tools.name: ff_check_and_plan
tools.description: Check a deployed URL and return its canonical ranked Fix List

tools.name: ff_recheck_and_compare
tools.description: After testing and deploying a product fix, run a fresh Re-check and return Fixed, Remaining, New, and Regressed Flags

tools.name: ff_get_check_status
tools.description: Check if a report is complete

tools.name: ff_get_report
tools.description: Get rubric summaries, report status, and the complete Fix List

tools.name: ff_get_rubric
tools.description: Get detailed flags and fix prompts for one rubric

tools.name: ff_get_flag
tools.description: Get the fix prompt for a specific Flag

tools.name: ff_get_all_fixes
tools.description: Get every unresolved Flag and fix prompt, ranked by launch impact

tools.name: ff_plan_mode_prompt
tools.description: Get one plan-mode prompt containing every ranked fix

tools.name: ff_get_product_context
tools.description: Get Product Contract and Product Intelligence context

tools.name: ff_compare
tools.description: Compare two reports to see what improved, stayed the same, or regressed

tools.name: ff_mark_fix_attempted
tools.description: Mark a Flag as fixed or ignored with an optional comment

tools.name: ff_list_recent_audits
tools.description: List recent audits with status, score, and key metadata

tools.name: generate-fix-prompt
tools.description: Generate a custom fix prompt from a problem description

tools.name: ff_start_repo_scan
tools.description: Start a GitHub repository code scan for an allow-listed repository

tools.name: ff_list_repo_scans
tools.description: List recent GitHub repository scans and finding counts

tools.name: ff_get_repo_scan
tools.description: Get a GitHub repository scan and its code findings

tools.name: ff_get_repo_finding
tools.description: Get a branch-ready fix task for one repository finding
